name: Workload Identity Federation for GKE
description: Connect pods on GKE to Google Cloud Storage (and other GCP APIs) without service-account key files. Credentials are short-lived and exchanged via the GKE metadata server. Application code uses Application Default Credentials (ADC).
forbidden: Service account JSON key files committed to the repo
Manual keyFilename / credentials JSON passed to Storage in production GKE
Manual key rotation workflows for GCS on GKE

steps.title: Annotate Kubernetes ServiceAccount (KSA) with GCP Service Account (GSA)
steps.detail: The pod runs with a Kubernetes ServiceAccount annotated with the GCP Service Account email (iam.gke.io/gcp-service-account=<GSA_EMAIL>).

steps.title: GKE metadata server exchanges KSA token for GSA token
steps.detail: GKE's metadata server intercepts the GCP credential request and exchanges the KSA token for a short-lived GSA token.

steps.title: IAM workloadIdentityUser binding
steps.detail: IAM verifies the KSA is bound to the GSA via the roles/iam.workloadIdentityUser binding (principal://.../kubernetes/sa/<KSA> → serviceAccount:<PROJECT>.iam.gserviceaccount.com/<GSA>).

steps.title: Pod receives GSA-scoped credentials
steps.detail: The pod receives GCP credentials scoped to the GSA's IAM roles — no key file, no secret rotation needed. Grant the GSA least-privilege roles on buckets (e.g. roles/storage.objectAdmin or objectViewer as required).

applicationCode.principle: Authenticate via Application Default Credentials (ADC): GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS locally, or workload identity on GKE. Do not pass keyFilename to Storage in production. Use a lazily-created Storage singleton cached on globalThis to avoid leaking clients across hot reloads (same pattern as db.ts).
applicationCode.authComment: Authenticates via Application Default Credentials (GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS or workload identity). The Storage client is a lazily-created singleton, cached on globalThis to avoid leaking clients across hot reloads (mirrors db.ts)

localDev.notes: Local development may set GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS to a short-lived or personal ADC path, or use gcloud auth application-default login. Never commit key files. On GKE, leave GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS unset so ADC uses WIF / metadata server.
